name: ConvertAPI
desc: Convert, merge and split documents, images and PDFs with 300+ file converters.

actions.name: merge_pdf
actions.description: Combine several PDF files into one PDF, in the order you list them.

actions.name: split_pdf
actions.description: Split a PDF into several PDFs by page count, page ranges, single pages, matching text or bookmarks.

actions.name: convert_file
actions.description: Convert a file to another format with any of ConvertAPI's converters, such as Word to PDF or PDF to JPG. Extra file inputs (like a template or overlay file) are not supported here; use Custom API Call for those.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
